# Studies that need a manual fetch

The automatic retrieval could not get full text for these studies. To add one by hand, save the PDF as `kraft-2023-data/studies/pdf/<key>.pdf` (the key is the first column below) and rerun `python3 analysis/16-kraft-retrieve.py`; the script adopts hand-supplied files, extracts their text, and logs them as `manual-pdf`. Nothing under `pdf/` is committed. If only the abstract is reachable, save it as `kraft-2023-data/studies/abstracts/<key>.txt` with four header lines (title, URL, `abstract source: hand-supplied`, blank line) followed by the abstract text; the script logs it as `abstract-only` with service `hand-supplied`.

| 997-wijekumar-2012 | wwc | 10.1007/s11423-012-9263-4 | Large-scale randomized controlled trial with 4th graders using intelligent tutoring of the structure strategy (ETR&D 2012) | paywalled Springer article; no abstract returned (re-retrieval 2026-09-18 after a mislinked NBER file was rejected) |
| 1000-wijekumar-2012 | wwc | 10.1007/s11423-012-9263-4 | Same article as 997 (Kraft twin row) | paywalled Springer article; save a PDF or abstract under both keys |
| 802-serveminnesota-2017 | bee | https://minnesotamathcorps.org/sites/default/files | Research brief: Minnesota Math Corps | dead or blocked link (the file was already gone from minnesotamathcorps.org by the 2022 Wayback snapshot; no earlier capture found). Andrew searched by hand on 2026-09-18 and found no copy. Closest available description is the abstract for study 662 (Parker et al. 2019, JREE, key 662-hamm-2019, abstract-only), the peer-reviewed Math Corps RCT from the same program; note its sample (550 students, grades 4-8, d = .17) differs from Kraft row 802 (284 students, grades 4-6, ES 0.20), so they may be different cohorts of the same program. Code 802 from that abstract at low confidence, or unclear. |
